issues.claim: "an independent shop inside a bp station on Georges Rd"
issues.problem: The bp location is directly sourced ('Located in: bp' on the Google listing). 'Independent' is not stated by any source I opened; it is a reasonable characterisation from the absence of any chain branding, but it is presented as fact.
issues.fix: Optional softening: 'an unbranded local shop inside a bp station' or footnote 'independent (our reading of the listing)'.

issues.problem: All three ranges are arithmetically correct against their own stated inputs and are labelled 'our assumption', so nothing is inflated. However section 1's input ('5-15 after-hours calls a week') is a different assumption from the one in analysis.json ('roughly 5-15 inbound calls per weekday'), so the audit's 6-31 hours/yr is far below the analysis' ~36-168 hours/yr. The audit is the more conservative document, so this is a consistency note, not an error.
issues.fix: No change required. If the founder later compares documents, note that the audit deliberately re-scoped the call volume to after-hours only.

issues.problem: Confirmed ('This profile has not been claimed by the business owner or representative'), but the same page's figures have moved since the profile was written: it now reads 4.4 from 51 reviews on the rendered page yet 4.5/44 in some cached/snippet views. The audit wisely cites only the 'unclaimed' status, so no number is at risk, but any future edit quoting Birdeye's rating should re-check it.
issues.fix: Keep quoting only the claim status, not Birdeye's rating/count.
